Thanks for agreeing to join a short group demo to see Redwood Inference in action. We want to run a 40–45 minute hybrid session (20m demo + 20m live Q&A) that works for both US and EU participants. To reduce back-and-forth, please pick your preferred slot in this quick poll: https://cal.com/redwood/hybrid-demo-poll?grp=2026-07

Slots (all 45m):
- Tue Jul 14 — 10:00 PT / 18:00 CEST
- Wed Jul 15 — 09:00 PT / 17:00 CEST
- Thu Jul 16 — 12:00 PT / 20:00 CEST (late EU-friendly)

Quick asks:
- Reply in-thread with your top slot if you prefer not to use the poll.
- Indicate if you need a private 1:1 follow-up for procurement/pricing (we can schedule this separate).
- If you have compliance questions (SOC2, data retention), flag them and I will loop in our security contact.

Attached is a 1-page demo outline to set expectations (demo-outline.pdf). We have limited interactive seats for the Q&A — if you need a deeper technical breakout we'll schedule immediately after.

Thanks — looking forward,
